The Cardinal were competing in their last season as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference]] after 45 years as they joined the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] in the 2024–25 season. They played home games at [[Maples Pavilion]]. They were led by eighth-year head coach [[Jerod Haase]], who was fired minutes after the team lost its last game of the season. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] went 14–19 overall and 7–13 in the Pac-12 conference. They finished 10th in the conference and would play 7th seed [[2022–23 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]] in the first round and won 73–62. In the quarterfinals they faced 2nd seed and 8th ranked [[2022–23 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] but lost 95–84.
